author: Bill Ferguson
name: toggle_group_view
description: Provides a shortcut that limits the lighttable display to a single image group and toggles back to the full view.
description-extensive: When you have photos organized into groups, this lets you press a shortcut to focus the lighttable on just one group, hiding everything else so you can work on it without distraction. Pressing the shortcut again brings back the full view of all your images. It is a simple convenience for browsing and reviewing grouped photos.
